Recommendation (text derived from the cells above)

1. HOLD the Base plan; do not act on the forecast alone. Base FY2027 revenue $1,706.2M, non-GAAP margin 19.3%, adjusted FCF $371.4M at 1.13x (range $328.5M-$403.5M). The Downside (faster deceleration, opex dollars unchanged) gives $1,626.5M and 15.3%, falling to 12.9% in Q4 2027. The Base-Downside revenue gap (4.7% of Base) is only 1.13x the average 4-quarter-ahead backtest miss, so the two cases cannot be told apart in advance: act on the triggers.

2. TRIGGERS (two consecutive quarters each; thresholds fixed at the lock date; NDR is NOT a trigger). T1 WATCH (pre-registered): revenue more than 1.04% below the Base path; fires on 3 of 8 backtest quarters (Q4 2024, Q3 2025, Q4 2025): review prompt only, no spending action. T1 ACTION: revenue at or below the Downside path ($390.0M in Q4 2026); chosen after the Watch result, backtest 0 fires of 8 (not out-of-sample; 4 near misses within $0.5M). T2 beat vs guidance midpoint below 1.48%: untested, calibrated at the minimum of the last 8 beats. T3 net adds of customers >$50k at or below 194: fired 4 times in 20 quarters, all 2021-2022, none in the last 8. Compare actuals on the guide basis: reported FY2026 adjusted FCF will include severance ($252.5M vs guide low $280.0M) and is not a miss if all severance is paid in 2026.

3. ACTIONS BY TIER: Watch = review only. Action tier (T1 Action or T2) = Lever 1, from Q2 2027 at the earliest (T2 can first fire on Q3+Q4 2026 results, reported February 2027; T1 Action not before Q4 2026+Q1 2027 results, reported May 2027). Lever 1: hold R&D+G&A 5% below plan, saving $19.3M in FY2027; it pays only if it costs less than $21.9M of FY2027 revenue (1.3%, 1.5 growth points). Lever 2 (S&M 10% below plan) saves $51.2M, breakeven $58.2M (3.6%, 3.9 points).

4. Lever 2 is CONDITIONAL, not automatic: use it only if T3 also fires. The breakeven is a one-year view and ignores the multi-year effect of cutting customer acquisition spend: revenue lost from customers not acquired recurs and compounds after 2027, while the saving can be reversed. The data cannot prove the growth cost; the illustrative mid case ($4.2M of FY2027 revenue) is 5% of the two-lever breakeven, but it rests on an assumed elasticity.

5. Q3 2026 at the call LOW lowers FY2027 revenue by $26.7M: $17.6M level shift and $9.1M from carrying weak Q3 growth into Q3 2027 under the same-quarter rule. With a smoothed base the effect is $28.7M ($11.1M rule effect). Not a trigger by itself.
